name: Baikonur Site 1/5 (Gagarin's Start)
tagline: Sputnik 1 (1957). Vostok 1 — Gagarin (1961). Five hundred and forty Soyuz launches from a single pad.
description: The single most historically significant orbital launch pad in the world. R-7 ICBM test stand from 1957; immediately repurposed for Sputnik 1 on October 4, 1957 — the start of the Space Age. Yuri Gagarin lifted from here on April 12, 1961. Every Vostok crew, every Voskhod, the bulk of all Soyuz manifests through to MS-15 in September 2019. Five hundred and forty launches from one pad over sixty-two years. Decommissioned for refurbishment; restoration is funded but the timeline is uncertain.
best_known_for: Sputnik 1 (1957). Vostok 1 — Gagarin (1961). Five hundred and forty Soyuz launches from a single pad.
